body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 2ed42c6097997dda2d2d7e546fd73908c91a6684 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Every refusal is by name through the post's `msg()` warning, same as the other posts: inch machine (G20 halts the firmware), tool 0 as the wireless probe, G41/G42 comp, tilted moves (one message per program), tap (`carvera.cps` onCycle), and probe ops (no probe hooks, so the engine refuses). Each is pinned: `an_inch_machine_is_refused_by_name`, `tool_zero_is_the_probe_and_refused_as_a_cutter`, `control_cutter_compensation_is_refused_by_name`, and `tap_plate` in the conformance REFUSED list. A dwell that never reaches its hole bottom is refused, not dropped.
- Clean-room provenance is recorded in the `carvera.cps` header and in `docs/decisions/707-carvera.md`: Makera's public spec tables, the manual, and the firmware supported-codes tables. It says no vendor post or CAM output was used. My grep for Fusion/HSMWorks found only the "Autodesk's published post docs" hook-contract mention, which is allowed.
- Machine figures cite Makera's spec tables with the read date. The decision file explains the choices (no `min_speed`, full-stroke travel, M7 air, 4th axis deferred, retailer listing dropped).
- The `MACHINES` entries are appended at the end and `machine.rs` expectations match. The other tests that iterate all machines (tormach_safe_retract, sinumerik_safe_retract, axis_direction, machine_assign) still pass.
- The goldens match the post. Re-running the suites left the tree clean, so the golden rewrite changed nothing.
- No `build.rs`, `.github`, scripts or dependency changes. The body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #707`, commits are conventional, `CHANGELOG.md` is untouched, and the new test modules carry provenance and gate-map headers.

**Local results (merged with upstream/main; it was already up to date, no conflicts)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| carvera_machines | 1 passed |
| carvera_post | 4 passed |
| conformance | 6 passed |
| machine | 32 passed |
| tormach_safe_retract | 4 passed |
| sinumerik_safe_retract | 3 passed |
| axis_direction | 12 passed |
| machine_assign | 3 passed |
| clippy `-D warnings` (app lib + carvera_machines, carvera_post, conformance, machine) | clean |

`cargo test -p camcraft-app --no-run` fails on main in `lathe_thread_travel` (#686: `missing field hand in initializer of OpParams`, tests/lathe_thread_travel.rs:83). That is not this PR, so I ran the touched suites one by one. I did not run the ui suites; the UI machines pane reads `MACHINES` generically.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
1. `carvera.cps` is about 324 lines, and posts are exempt from the 400-line rule anyway.
2. As the PR says, nothing has been run on a real Carvera or in Carvera Controller. Please have someone with the machine run `golden/nc/carvera/two_tool_pocket.nc` before the post is trusted. The program ends at the last retract with no G53 move, which the decision file explains.
3. The goldens are text only, so there is no platform-dependent snapshot here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
